title: HK RBC three-pillar framework
source_title: Consultation Paper on the Draft RBC Rules (11 January 2024)
content: The framework distinguishes quantitative valuation, capital quality and capital requirements (Pillar 1), qualitative enterprise risk management (Pillar 2), and reporting to the IA plus public disclosure (Pillar 3). The paper identifies GL21 as implementing Pillar 2.
authority: Hong Kong Insurance Authority / HKSAR Government

title: Capital adequacy thresholds
source_title: Insurance (Valuation and Capital) Rules, L.N. 62 of 2024
content: Subject to rule 5(2), an applicable insurer must maintain capital base at least equal to each of its prescribed capital amount, minimum capital amount and HK$20 million. Capital base follows Part 3; PCA follows Part 5.

title: Minimum capital amount baseline
source_title: Insurance (Valuation and Capital) Rules, L.N. 62 of 2024
content: MCA is 50% of PCA unless the IA determines another amount through the variation or relaxation mechanism in rule 5(2).
version: As originally gazetted in 2024; not current consolidation

title: IA variation or relaxation
source_title: Insurance (Valuation and Capital) Rules, L.N. 62 of 2024
content: Where the IA varies or relaxes rule 5(1) requirements under Ordinance section 10(3) or 130(1), the insurer determines the requirement as varied or relaxed.

title: Natural catastrophe own assessment approval
source_title: IA guidance appendices for implementation of Cap. 41R
content: The guidance describes a factor-based natural-catastrophe RCA under rule 68 as the default under rule 67; using an own-assessment approach requires IA approval and ongoing information submission.

title: 2026 rule changes and future commencement
source_title: Gazettal of subsidiary legislation under risk-based capital regime for insurance industry
content: The release announces gazettal of public-disclosure rules and 2026 valuation/capital amendments. Public-disclosure rules commence on gazettal; the RBC review amendments are scheduled for 31 December 2026. The release describes infrastructure, general-business, matching-adjustment and crypto/stablecoin changes.
version: Government announcement; announced changes, not consolidated rule text
authority: Hong Kong Insurance Authority / HKSAR Government
verification_method: Official government HTML release opened and official indexed release text reviewed.

limits: 31 December 2026 relates to the review amendments only, not separate public-disclosure rules. As of 2026-10-24, do not apply future review amendments as already operative. Negative-vetting outcome and later notices were not independently verified.
